items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I remember the one in California, that guy, that Big Bill Moore. You had to see Big Bill Moore before you could sit in.

ctx.x: The only thing that will save it, man, is if ______ joins, becomes legalized again, that people have a place to go jam and sing. It's organized, most jams is organized. I remember the one in California, that guy, that Big Bill Moore. You had to see Big Bill Moore before you could sit in. He wasn't the biggest tenor player, but he'd say if you couldn't play enough to make sense with the guys up there, he wouldn't let you sit in.
And Lockjaw Davis did the same thing in business. You ever heard that?
